verdict.rationale: Undermind does not return a single unqualified answer. It produces a ranked list of papers with a written synthesis whose inline citations trace each statement to its source paper. It can also answer specific questions across many papers at once and generate custom tables, which gives an analyst a per-source view to compare. However, no evidence shows it explicitly identifies or presents where sources agree versus conflict. Missing for 10: explicit agreement/disagreement or consensus mapping, documentation of how conflicting findings are surfaced in the synthesis, hands-on corroboration of contradiction handling.
